item.description:
The professionalization release: Spire now distributes, updates, explains, and removes itself the way a real product does.

Added

  • Public distribution channel: download page and Sparkle feed at updates.noeticaperture.com, artifacts on GitHub Releases (Truth-Forge/spire-releases), public issue tracker.
  • Headless self-update: spire-mlx update checks the feed, verifies both the EdDSA update signature and Apple notarization, and performs a stop → swap → reinstall → health-check → rollback cycle without a logged-in user. The daemon schedules a daily check on the Studios.
  • Diagnostics export: one command collects daemon logs, health state, crash reports, and redacted configuration into a single shareable archive.
  • Whole-app uninstall: removes the daemon, app bundle, configuration, logs, and (on request) model weights.
  • Help menu: links to the download page, release history, and issue tracker.

Changed

  • scripts/publish-update.sh now publishes end-to-end: renders release notes from this changelog into the appcast, uploads the artifact to GitHub Releases, and updates the feed and download page.

First distributed release.

Added

  • Container control plane: typed SpireDeployment manifests rendered into reviewable Apple container commands, with a deny-by-default capability broker between the GUI/CLI and mutation.
  • MLX inference host (spire-mlx): chat, embedding, and rerank roles served concurrently over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with per-role health.
  • MCP server (spire-mcp) so AI agents can drive deployments under operator-granted capabilities.
  • SwiftUI app with onboarding, settings, menu-bar presence, and Sparkle auto-update; spire CLI sharing the same model.
  • Fleet daemon lifecycle: spire-mlx install-daemon installs a system LaunchDaemon on headless hosts and fails loudly unless launchd reports the service running.
  • Signing chain: Developer ID, hardened runtime, notarization, stapling — verified with a quarantined copy on a second Mac.
